_about: PARKED DRAFT (docs/narrative/pending/). Between-stage beats for a run across one planet (docs/narrative/story-beats.md). Each beat names the run state it needs; a beat is two to four short lines. The state fields are Narrative's proposal; Game Design's run-mode.md (docs/design) decides the real ones. Every line passes the lint (4 to 12 words, banned words, ellipsis cap). Speakers: hero (the player's fighter, voiced as the Protagonist for now), rival, boss, crowd, radio (an in-world broadcast, never a narrator). Unsearched by Legal; for Orb's marks. Version 3 (2026-10-16) adds the lives, the buff and the two boss paths from Orb's homework 26 answers: 31 new beats and 63 lines.

state.stage: early (stages 1 and 2) | mid | late (the stage before the boss)
state.cities: none (0) | some (1 or 2) | many (3 or more): cities fallen this run
state.city_cause: hero | rival | boss | both (whoever did 60% or more of the building damage to cities; otherwise both)
state.casualties: none (under 1%) | some (1 to 10%) | many (over 10%): the share of the people present killed in the last stage
state.branch: none | witnessed | tested (the hero's branch; anguish-branches.md)
state.menace: low (under 30) | mid (30 to 69) | high (70 or more): the villain's menace at the stage's end
state.result: won | won_close | lost_close | lost (the stage just finished)
state.boss_in: 3 | 2 | 1 | 0 (stages until the boss; 0 is the final approach)
state.boss: rival | empress | cyborg | any (the MVP's boss is the rival)
state.avoided_towns: true when the hero kept the fight away from settlements
state.rival_here: true when the rival appears in this gap
state.revisit: damaged | fallen (the next stage crosses a place the run has hurt; its name is {place})
state.fallen_name: true when a place fell in the last stage; its name is {place}
state.wound_carried: true when the hero goes in with a region broken
state.sky: true when the sky has darkened (the boss fight only)
state.chances: left | none (a chance to spend after a loss)
state.retry: true when the stage will be replayed (the boss once, or the assist)
state.fight: 1 to 5 (the fights before the boss; the reshaped run is five fights and a boss)
state.lives: many (three or more) | two | last (lives left after the loss; supersedes chances)
state.buff: offered | enticing_taken | modest_taken | refused (the choice offered between fights 2 and 3)
state.buff_age: fresh (the gap straight after the choice) | carried
state.boss_path: default | rival_escape (the rival let the boss go in fight 5) | empress_down (the Empress was beaten in fight 5 and the Cyborg appears with one form left)
state.motive: pride | appetite | silent (which reason the rival gives for the escape; one is chosen by Orb)

lines.text: Nothing broken. Good. Let's keep it that way.
The city's untouched. Stay clear of the fighting.

beats.note: A clean first stage.

lines.text: Three fights and no city's hurt. Keep going.
Don't get smug. I'm still here.

beats.note: A clean run so far; the rival is in the gap.

lines.text: I broke that street. I know it.
Look at the windows. All of them.
Next time I'm taking it somewhere empty.

beats.note: One city damaged by the hero's own blows: shame, not power.

lines.text: You didn't have to hit the street!
It was in the way.
People live on that street!

beats.note: A city damaged by the rival, who is present.

lines.text: Three cities down. All because of me.
We trusted you to keep it away.

beats.note: The cost of fighting in cities, owned by the hero.

lines.text: He flattened three cities and kept walking.
Three cities lost. The fighting follows him.

beats.note: The rival's trail of damage.

lines.text: Look at that. We did that together.
Don't say 'we'. I didn't want this.

beats.note: Both fighters share the damage; the rival needles.

lines.text: You took it out to the hills. Thank you.
Just doing my job. Is everyone okay?

beats.note: The hero lured the fight away from people.

lines.text: Is everybody out? Count them again.
We're all safe. Thanks to you.

beats.note: No one died; a check anyway.

lines.text: People got hurt. Because of me.
My brother was in that building.
I'm sorry. I should've been faster.

beats.note: Casualties the hero caused: grief and apology, no power-up.

lines.text: You were supposed to protect us!
I know. I'm sorry.

beats.note: Many casualties, hero's fault: the crowd turns on him.

lines.text: They were just standing there. Why?
They shouldn't have stayed.

beats.note: The rival's casualties: the setup for the witnessed branch.

lines.text: That's too many. I'm done being polite.
Finally. Now you look like you mean it.

beats.note: Many casualties by the rival: the Protagonist stops playing.

lines.text: Two districts didn't make it out.
Whoever's behind this did it on purpose.

beats.note: Casualties the boss caused.

lines.text: I'm not playing anymore.
Good. That's the look I wanted.
Stay behind me. All of you.

beats.note: Branch A begins (anguish-branches.md).

lines.text: No jokes. Not tonight.
You finally look dangerous.

beats.note: Branch A continues across a stage.

lines.text: Is anyone hurt? Anyone at all?
We're okay. We're all okay.
Good. I can breathe again.

beats.note: Branch A fades when no one else is hurt.

lines.text: That form of yours was incredible. Seriously.
Don't compliment me. Fight me.
I am! This is what I wanted!

beats.note: Branch B begins: the hero let the rival power up first.

lines.text: Higher every fight. I love it.
You're enjoying this too much.

beats.note: Branch B continues.

lines.text: Let the boss go first. I want to see it.
You're insane. That's why you're annoying.

beats.note: Branch B looks ahead to the boss.

lines.text: That's it? I'm barely warm.
Then let's get you warm!

beats.note: The rival is bored; the hero is eager.

lines.text: You're improving. Don't let it go to your head.
Thanks! Hey, you're good too!

beats.note: A tepid compliment from the rival.

lines.text: You asked for my best. Here it comes.
Everybody back! He's serious this time!

beats.note: The rival at full menace.

lines.text: That man in the glasses scares me.
He's rough, but he's not here for you.

beats.note: A civilian's view of the rival.

lines.text: Don't lose to the boss. That's my job.
Is that your way of saying good luck?

beats.note: The rival's pride claims the boss.

lines.text: That was close! My arms are shaking!
Lucky. That's all that was.

beats.note: A narrow win.

lines.text: One more hit. I was that close.
Close doesn't count. Try again.
Get up! You almost had him!

beats.note: A narrow loss that will be replayed (the assist, or the boss's one replay).

lines.text: I was down to my last breath.
And you got up. Annoying.
He almost fell! And then he didn't!

beats.note: A win after being nearly beaten.

lines.text: Round two. Same fight, smarter me.
Again? You never learn.

beats.note: A win after losing the stage before.

lines.text: Three wins since that loss. Feels good.
Don't count them. I'm still counting.

beats.note: A run of wins since a loss.

lines.text: Something's coming. The sky's gone dark up north.
Whatever it is, we'll be ready.

beats.note: Three stages out: the first sign.

lines.text: Three more districts evacuated. The ground's shaking.
Do you feel that? The whole street's humming.

beats.note: Two stages out.

lines.text: It's close. I can feel it in my teeth.
Stay with me. Last one before it.

beats.note: One stage out.

lines.text: The sky's gone black. Ash everywhere.
It's the middle of the day!
Everyone inside! Now! Move!

beats.note: Set piece 1 of 8: the sky changes.

lines.text: Final evacuation order. Leave the cities now.
Take the children! Go!
Go! I'll hold it off.

beats.note: Set piece 2 of 8: the last evacuation.

lines.text: Don't misunderstand. I just want the first hit.
I wasn't going to say anything.

beats.note: Set piece 3 of 8: the rival joins, on his own terms.

lines.text: There you are. I was getting bored.
You're the one behind all this?

beats.note: Set piece 4 of 8: the boss arrives (generic).

lines.text: Petitioners! You're late. We've started without you.
Spare me the speech.

beats.note: Set piece 4 of 8: the Empress arrives.

lines.text: Welcome, gentlemen! Your table's been waiting.
I'm not eating here.

beats.note: Set piece 4 of 8: the Cyborg arrives.

lines.text: You hurt them. That ends now.
Then try to stop me.

beats.note: Set piece 5 of 8: the hero in branch A.

lines.text: Show me everything. I'll wait.
Careful. I don't do half measures.

beats.note: Set piece 5 of 8: the hero in branch B.

lines.text: Let's finish this. Everybody back!
Everyone back? How sweet of you.

beats.note: Set piece 5 of 8: the hero, no branch.

lines.text: Stay out of my way. This one's mine.
Not a chance. We do this together.

beats.note: Set piece 6 of 8: the two argue over the boss.

lines.text: Look at the sky. That's what I do.
Stop it! There are people down there!

beats.note: Set piece 7 of 8: the boss's threat (generic).

lines.text: Watch the sky, petitioners. It's our province now.
Stop it! There are people down there!

beats.note: Set piece 7 of 8: the Empress's threat.

lines.text: Dinner is served, gentlemen. The whole planet.
Stop it! There are people down there!

beats.note: Set piece 7 of 8: the Cyborg's threat.

lines.text: Here we go! Give me everything!
Don't die before I hit it.
Come on, then. Entertain us.

beats.note: Set piece 8 of 8: the first blow.

lines.text: Both of us did this. I know it.
Stop fighting over our streets!

beats.note: Casualties both fighters share.

lines.text: One more hit. I was that close.
{place} has fallen. The people got out.

beats.note: A narrow loss: the place falls and the run goes on.

lines.text: One more hit. I was that close.
Close doesn't save a city.
{place} has fallen. The people got out.

beats.note: The same, with the rival there.

lines.text: He's faster than me. I need to see why.
{place} has fallen. Everyone's out.

beats.note: A clear loss: the place falls; the hero is curious, not crushed.

lines.text: He's faster than me. I need to see why.
You're not even trying to win.
{place} has fallen. Everyone's out.

beats.note: The same, with the rival there.

lines.text: Where do we go now?
I'm sorry. I did everything I could.

beats.note: The end-of-run beat: no chance left.

lines.text: Where do we go now?
I'm sorry. I did everything I could.
Then get up and do more.

beats.note: The end-of-run beat, with the rival there.

lines.text: Again. This time I'm ready.
Back already? I wasn't finished.

beats.note: The boss fight is replayed once.

lines.text: Back in {place}. It still hasn't recovered.
Half the street is still rubble.
Let's not make it worse.

beats.note: The next stage crosses a damaged place.

lines.text: {place} is empty now. Nobody came back.
Keep moving. There's nothing we can save here.

beats.note: The next stage crosses a fallen place (ruins are crossed, not fought in).

lines.text: {place} is gone. We won, and still lost it.
Where do we live now?

beats.note: A place fell during a stage the hero won.

lines.text: I'm still hurt. Doesn't matter.
You're hurt. Please, sit down.

beats.note: The hero goes in with a broken region.

lines.text: Limping already? Then fight harder.
I can still hit. Come on.

beats.note: The same, with the rival there.

lines.text: The blast cloud hasn't cleared. It's dark at noon.
We'll see the sun again.

beats.note: The sky has darkened (boss fight only).

lines.text: Come find me. I'm not hiding.
Good. I wasn't going to look long.

beats.note: Three stages out, the rival is the boss.

lines.text: Next stage, I'm waiting. Don't be late.
I'll be there. Hold nothing back.

beats.note: One stage out, the rival is the boss.

lines.text: Hurry up. I'm not waiting forever.
He's not running. He wants this.

beats.note: Set piece 3 of 8, when the rival is the boss: he waits.

lines.text: Took you long enough. Let's finish this.
Not here. Away from the town!

beats.note: Set piece 4 of 8: the rival is the boss.

lines.text: No tricks. Full power. Both of us.
That's what I've wanted all along.

beats.note: Set piece 6 of 8: the rival is the boss and asks for everything.

lines.text: Hold nothing back. I won't.
Stop! There are people down there!

beats.note: Set piece 7 of 8: the rival is the boss.

lines.text: Ow. Okay, that's one. Again!
Medics are with you. Stay down a second.

beats.note: A loss with lives to spare: he shrugs it off.

lines.text: That one hurt. I'm still in this.
Two left? Then stop being so polite.

beats.note: A loss with two lives left; the rival needles.

lines.text: That's my last one. Let's not waste it.
No more spares. This is the last one.

beats.note: The last life.

lines.text: Last life? Then I'm not holding back.
Good. I don't want you to.

beats.note: The last life, with the rival there.

lines.text: Take this. You've earned another go.
Thanks. I'll make good use of it.

beats.note: An extra life earned.

lines.text: Two to choose from. The big one's tempting.
Too good to be free. What's the catch?
Take it. Quit being so careful.

beats.note: The offer between fights 2 and 3: a modest buff and an enticing one.

lines.text: Whoa. That's a lot of power!
Good. Now you can keep up.

beats.note: He took the big buff. The rival approves.

lines.text: Whoa. That's a lot of power!
Is it supposed to feel like that?

beats.note: The same, without the rival: a crowd's doubt.

lines.text: Small, but I'll take it.
Small? You had a bigger choice.

beats.note: He took the safe buff. The rival sneers.

lines.text: No, thanks. I'll do it myself.
Free power, and you walk away?

beats.note: He took neither.

lines.text: I'm fast today. Almost too fast.

beats.note: Fight 4: the buff shows in how he moves.

lines.text: I'm hitting harder. I like it too much.
Then don't stop now.

beats.note: Fight 5: a little worry about the buff.

lines.text: Borrowed strength, petitioner. We can tell.

beats.note: The Empress notices the buff in the final approach.

lines.text: You're done! Nowhere left to run!
You think this is over? Look again.

beats.note: Escape path, step 1: the boss is down to the last ropes.

lines.text: That's far enough. Back off.
What are you doing? Move!
I said back off. Not him. Not now.

beats.note: Escape path, step 2: the rival steps between them.

lines.text: Our thanks, rival. We will remember this.
Wait! Get back here!

beats.note: Escape path, step 3: the Empress leaves.

lines.text: Withdrawing, sirs. Thank you for your patience.
Wait! Get back here!

beats.note: Escape path, step 3: the Cyborg leaves.

lines.text: We'll finish this another time.
Wait! Get back here!

beats.note: Escape path, step 3: any boss leaves.

lines.text: Why did you do that?
He's mine to beat. Not yours.
Then you'd better beat him.

beats.note: Escape path, step 4, motive one: pride.

lines.text: Why did you do that?
You'll get a bigger fight later. Be grateful.
I'd rather have it now.

beats.note: Escape path, step 4, motive two: he wants the fight to be bigger.

lines.text: Why did you do that?
Don't ask me that.
I'm asking you anyway.

beats.note: Escape path, step 4, motive three: he will not say.

lines.text: He's slipped away. Last seen heading out to sea.
He'll be back. Stronger.

beats.note: After the escape.

lines.text: You thought us gone, petitioner. We were resting.

beats.note: The final approach after the escape: the Empress returns.

lines.text: Fully repaired, sirs. Thank you for waiting.

beats.note: The final approach after the escape: the Cyborg returns.

lines.text: I'm back. Did you miss me?

beats.note: The final approach after the escape: any boss returns.

lines.text: No tricks this time. He's all yours.
Are you sure about this?
Don't make me regret it.

beats.note: The final approach after the escape: the rival stands aside.

lines.text: The Empress has fallen. Hold your positions.
Is it really over now?

beats.note: Fight 5: the Empress is beaten.

lines.text: Excuse me, sirs. I'll take it from here.
Who are you, exactly?
Your final technician, sir.

beats.note: The Cyborg appears at the end of fight 5.

lines.text: One configuration remains. Please don't make me use it.
Watch it. He's got one more form.

beats.note: The final approach: the Cyborg has one form left before his last.

lines.text: One configuration remains. Please don't make me use it.
That sounds bad. I'm ready.

beats.note: The same, without the rival.

lines.text: Penultimate configuration engaged. Apologies for the noise.

beats.note: The Cyborg's extra form starts, ahead of his last.
